description: A reusable page recipe for documenting one governed CMS object.
name: Object reference page

data.body: Explain what the object owns, what depends on it, and what its contract requires.
data.heading: Object type

data.body:
Function

Describe what the object owns and which surfaces consume it.

Contract

List required attributes, typed operations, references, and publish gates from the live object contract.

whenToUse: Use for a type reference that needs an introduction followed by repeatable explanation, examples, or comparison blocks.
